contexts.text: To eat of every tree () = to know from perception what is good and true.
This is to eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil... AC 192.
Good to eat () = cupidity.
To eat of the ground in great sorrow () = a miserable state of life. To eat = to live.
To eat the herb of the field () = to live like a wild beast.
To eat bread in the sweat of the countenance () = to be averse to what is celestial.
To take of the tree of lives and eat () = to know even so as to acknowledge whatever is of love and faith. To eat, here, = to know.
I asked why he, who was a Spirit, desired to eat. He said that he did eat, and that when he desired to eat, nothing but mire was offered him...
Eating with man corresponds to scientifics in the World of Spirits.
To eat and drink before the Lord () = to teach and preach the good and truth of faith from Knowledges from the Word. AE 212:3.
To eat and drink upon the Lord's table in His Kingdom () = to enjoy the perception of good and truth.
To eat () = to be communicated and appropriated.

They did eat and drink () = the appropriation of good and truth thus initiated. To eat = to be communicated and conjoined, thus to be appropriated; and as it is predicated of bread, and bread = good, it is the appropriation of good which is signified by to eat. AC 3333. AC 3457. AC 3503. AC 3513. AC 3513:2. AC 3521. AC 3552.
To eat = to conjoin and appropriate. AE 146:2.
To eat = to be conjoined and appropriated as to good.
To eat = to appropriate. AC 3595. AC 4984. AC 9295:2. AE 304:45.

After the eating there followed the blessing of him who had made the savoury meat and brought it (). The reason is evident from an internal understanding of the rituals of the Ancient Church; for, with them, eating signified appropriation and conjunction, and conjunction with him with whom they had eaten, or of whose bread they had eaten... The eatings of the sanctified things in the Jewish Church represented nothing else...
If He will give me bread to eat () = even to conjunction with Divine good... To eat = to be communicated, appropriated, and conjoined.
Under Corpse, see this reference.
The Sons of Israel eat not the sinew of what is put out... () = that those things are not appropriated in which are falsities. To eat = to be conjoined and appropriated.
Eating and drinking () = their state as to the appropriation of evil and falsity...
Everything that serves for eating, or that is eaten... is predicated of good, and thus relates to the voluntary part.
The bird did eat them out of the basket... () = that the falsity from evil consumed it... To eat = to consume; for the term here used for to eat in the Original Language denotes to consume. AC 5157.
Have delight... only in eating, drinking...

That he may eat bread () = confirmation in good... because to eat, here, means feasting... and feasts were held among the Ancients within the Church for the sake of conjunction and of confirmation in good.
The profanation of truth was signified by the eating of blood...
A prohibition to eat anything but bread.
When we did eat bread to satiety () = that thus they enjoyed the good of pleasures as much as they wanted. To eat = appropriation, and also enjoyment.
In Jehovah's giving you in the evening flesh to eat () = that in the end of the state good will be appropriated through delight.
This is the bread which Jehovah hath given you to eat () = that this is the good which will be appropriated and will make their life; in the supreme sense, that this is the Lord in you. AC 8464:end.
Gather ye of it everyone to the mouth of his eating () = reception and appropriation according to the capacity of each one.
To eat = enjoyment and appropriation. References.
The reason it was forbidden to eat of this tree, was that the regenerate man... ought no longer to be led by the understanding of truth, but by the will of good. References.
To eat and drink () = to be instructed in the good and truth of faith.

To eat lambs of the flock () = to learn and appropriate to themselves the goods of innocence which are of the internal man; and to eat calves out of the midst of the fatted ones = to learn and appropriate to themselves the goods of innocence which are of the external man. AE 279:4.
To eat and drink (the Lord's flesh and blood), in Heaven = to appropriate and conjoin.
The people sat to eat and drink () = the appropriation of them. To eat = the appropriation of evil; and to drink, the appropriation of falsity.

He did not eat bread, and he did not drink water () = meanwhile no appropriation of the good of love and of the truth of faith... To eat = the conjunction and appropriation of good; and to drink, the reception and appropriation of truth.
A man may eat and drink delicately, provided he does not make his life to consist therein. SE 5794.

Uses created for the nourishment of the body comprise all things of the vegetable kingdom which are For eating and drinking; as fruits, berries, seeds, pulse, and herbs; also all things of the animal kingdom which are eaten; as oxen, cows, bullocks, deer, sheep, kids, goats, lambs, and the milk of these; also fowls and fish of many kinds.
Eating of the tree of knowledge = the appropriation of good and truth as not from the Lord... but as from man.

I will give to eat of the tree of life () = the appropriation of the good of love and of charity from the Lord... The reason to eat = to appropriate, is that as when natural food is eaten it is appropriated to the life of man's body, so when spiritual food is received it is appropriated to the life of his soul. AE 109.
I will give him to eat of the hidden manna () = wisdom, and in that case the appropriation of the good of celestial love in works, and thus the conjunction of the Lord with those who work. AE 146.
To eat things sacrificed to idols () = the defilement of worship thence. ( = to imbue evils and thence falsities. AE 141.)
Thus he wanted to eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil... ISB 13:5.
On the stench of intemperance [in eating].
The appetite of eating can be induced on Spirits. General article.

The appetite of eating is excited with Spirits, although they know... that they cannot eat; and that too for certain kinds of food; as... today, when I promised to eat the like things, he was at rest...
Souls have appetites, as the appetite of eating when they see food such as they had desired in the life of the body...

When a man is sitting in conversation at table, he ought to eat longer and more, that the salivary ducts may be opened, and that his food may the better serve for nutrition, because such is the correspondence of spiritual food... Which food is that of instruction by means of conversation.
Thus the cupidity of eating causes that whatever he sees he considers whether it is to be purchased for use.
Sirens want to enter into the taste, and seize for themselves whatever I may be eating... SE 3858.
Under Conscience, see this reference.
It is utterly forbidden that the function of eating and the taste should be taken possession of by any Spirit.

I thought in the street about eating, or of what I should eat... and I perceived that the Angels thought of nothing of the kind, but of Knowledges and knowledge, and that thence there came forth into my thought, together with those in the World of Spirits, the thought of eating. I spoke to them about it, and was informed that it was so...

When the Africans are in a longing for truths, they go and seek foods; and that this is innate with them is evident from their little children, who frequently say to their nurses that they want to eat; and when food is given them, they clearly see whether it agrees, and this from correspondence; and after they have eaten they again ask to eat; from which it is evident that it is spiritual hunger which is the cause of this.
They had been devoted solely to pleasure, chiefly that of eating...
To eat and drink = to be instructed and to be appropriated. AE 750:16. Be not solicitous... as to what ye shall eat... To eat = to perceive good intellectually and thus spiritually.
To eat and drink () = to live for themselves and the world, and to appropriate to themselves evils and falsities.
